slot.brief: Simple sentence testing 'used to' vs 'be used to' or a basic preposition; one clearly correct option at this level.

stem: My grandfather ______ walk several kilometres to school when he was a boy.

verdicts.working: “Used to” expresses a repeated past action; “walk” is the base verb.

working:
“Used to” expresses a past habit. “Is used to” needs a noun or gerund; “was used” is incomplete here; “use to” is incorrect in this affirmative sentence.

Independent check: “Used to” expresses a repeated past action; “walk” is the base verb.
solution: “Used to” expresses a repeated past action and is followed by the base verb “walk”; hence, “My grandfather used to walk several kilometres to school.”
